## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12827 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-16T23:47Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `007092e`, against the card's Target, the triage note (`6226312983`) and the claim (`6226360545`).

- **Shape:** the body says `Fixes #12805`; the second line is `Clause-②: no`. The changeset is `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`. Nothing is added to the package entry: the new module `packages/app-shell/src/views/viewTabLabel.ts` is internal.
- **The change:**
  - objectui#12774's `viewTabLabel` moves unchanged out of `ObjectView.tsx` into `viewTabLabel.ts`. The tab, the mobile switcher, the record page's way back and now the header all read that one function, so there is one derivation, not two.
  - On a `/apps/APP/OBJECT/view/NAME` route, `AppHeader` passes `viewDef?.label || viewDef?.title` and the object's plural label (`objectPluralLabel(currentObject)`, already resolved in the header; no second fetch). A label-less view is titled like its tab; ⛔ no string humanized from the machine name.
  - Kept: label-then-title precedence; served views drawn as given and other views through the bundle (objectui#11295); an unresolved object keeps its earlier path.
  - Changed, as intended: a URL view name that matches no view on a resolved object also reads the plural label (the page itself falls back to the default view there).
  - Dashboards, pages and reports are left alone: their spec requires a `label`, so they have no label-less case.
- **Pins:** `AppHeader.labelLessViewTitle-12805` (8 cases, en and zh-CN): a label-less served view on bare and qualified URLs and a label-less embedded view equal the tab's name; CONTROLs keep a `label` and keep a `title`. **Ablation:** putting `humanizeSlug(viewName)` back turns the 6 label-less cases red with both controls green; the restore was proven by blob hash. 80 `AppHeader*` / `ObjectView*` test files (669 tests) and 87 source-reading files (1973 tests) are green; `app-shell` type-check exits 0.
- **Acceptance notes, not filed:** the kept `viewDef.title` read names a key that spec `18.0.0-next.2`'s `ListViewSchema` refuses, so it fires only on a non-spec document. It is dormant, and it was kept by ruling.
- **Trailers:** every commit carries only the model-free pair.
- **CI at head:** 33 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`, 36 runs). Not governed (path audit); 378 changed lines.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.

## Landed · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-16T23:59Z

PR #12827 merged through the merge queue as `3288c12`, which is on `main`; `Fixes #12805` closed this card. Verified by content: all 5 of the PR's files on `main` are blob-identical to the accepted head `007092e`. The merge commit's message names no model.

What landed:
- On a `/apps/APP/OBJECT/view/NAME` route, a view with no `label` and no `title` is titled by its object's plural label, the same name its tab shows (objectui#12774's rule). The header no longer humanizes the view's machine name.
- The tab, the mobile switcher, the record page's way back and the header all read one function, `viewTabLabel` (now `packages/app-shell/src/views/viewTabLabel.ts`, internal; nothing added to the package entry).
- Released as `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.

Not measured in a browser: the published `18.0.0-next.2` backend still invents a view `label`, so the label-less case shows only once objectstack PR #24013 is in the runtime the console talks to. This seat now removes `pm:dispatched`.
